capabilities.name: Native SwiftUI application shell
open_gaps: No complete conversation window, text fallback, capability center, task center, model center, or memory center.
capabilities.notes: Operational shell, not yet a complete assistant UX.

capabilities.name: Push-to-Talk voice activation
open_gaps: Live long-duration soak, external microphone/device-switch matrix, barge-in/echo recovery, and transcript UI.
capabilities.notes: Primary supported production activation path; wake-word enablement is explicitly excluded until qualified.

capabilities.name: Real local wake-word activation
open_gaps: No evaluated production acoustic model, Turkish support, license/hash, FAR/FRR, noise/distance, self-trigger, or soak evidence.
capabilities.notes: DisabledWakeWordDetector is the truthful production path; MarkerWakeWordDetector is test-only.

capabilities.name: Local audio capture
open_gaps: Release-hardware soak and sleep/wake/device-change recovery evidence.
capabilities.notes: Ambient retention must remain disabled by default.

capabilities.name: Voice activity detection
open_gaps: Adaptive calibration and real acoustic environment evaluation.
capabilities.notes: Energy-based implementation.

capabilities.name: Apple on-device Speech transcription
open_gaps: Live Turkish/English/mixed WER/entity evaluation, qualified local Whisper/equivalent fallback, microphone/TCC evidence, and live device recovery.
capabilities.notes: Ordered local locale fallback with capability checks; requires on-device recognition and does not silently rewrite a transcript on quality grounds.

capabilities.name: Apple system TTS fallback
open_gaps: Release-hardware latency and human quality evidence.
capabilities.notes: Yelda is the safe local fallback.

capabilities.name: Chatterbox Multilingual V3 neural TTS
open_gaps: MPS remains unqualified, CPU first-audio/latency and human quality evidence are open, and consented reference/hash/license/cache/soak gates remain.
capabilities.notes: CPU is the safe default; helper timeout, resource admission, cleanup, and Yelda fallback must fail closed to system TTS when neural gates are unmet.

capabilities.name: General multi-turn conversation
open_gaps: Open conversation returns a fixed acknowledgement; no model-backed dialogue or multi-turn slot state.
capabilities.notes: Conversation state machine exists; reasoning path does not.

capabilities.name: Natural-language intent classification
open_gaps: English-only closed grammar, tiny application/executable dictionaries, no bilingual model-assisted schema.
capabilities.notes: Safe but too narrow for the intended product.

capabilities.name: Local Ollama model routing
open_gaps: Not connected to production dialogue, NLU, or computer-use planning; network enforcement and live model evidence required.
capabilities.notes: Strong adapter foundation.

capabilities.name: Application discovery and lifecycle
open_gaps: Hardcoded app-name map, limited Turkish aliases, incomplete hide/discovery/open URL/file capabilities.
capabilities.notes: One of the few end-to-end reachable tool paths.

capabilities.name: Typed shell execution
open_gaps: Very narrow voice grammar, confirmation semantics, contextual working directory, and helper separation.
capabilities.notes: Destructive patterns are conservatively escalated.

capabilities.name: Approved-window screen context and redaction
open_gaps: No user-facing observation route, no active capability registration, and live redaction/permission matrix incomplete.
capabilities.notes: Strong orchestration and zero-retention defaults.

capabilities.name: Bounded computer-use control loop
open_gaps: No production planner, voice/UI route, persisted confirmation resume, beta app allowlist, or live end-to-end evidence.
capabilities.notes: Executor has real Accessibility/CGEvent code but product path is disconnected.

capabilities.name: Structured browser automation and page reading
open_gaps: Safari Web Extension target/native-messaging packaging, composition-root and NLU/UI reachability, mutation capabilities, and live approved-profile acceptance remain open.
capabilities.notes: Read-only browser.read is typed and disabled truthfully until the structured bridge is packaged and wired. Computer use remains a fallback, not the primary integration.

capabilities.name: Mail read, summarize, draft, and send
open_gaps: No live Gmail transport/account consent, composition-root reachability, draft review, immutable send confirmation, post-action verification, or live injection acceptance.
capabilities.notes: Gmail read-only scope, Keychain reference, account ambiguity, provenance, and revoke behavior are contract-tested; compose/send remain unimplemented and disabled.

capabilities.name: Calendar agenda and event management
open_gaps: EventKit authorization/composition-root reachability, draft/write/delete flows, attendee confirmation, provider verification, and live acceptance remain open.
capabilities.notes: EventKit read adapter, explicit permission boundary, provenance mapping, and conflict logic are implemented; read agenda remains disabled until wiring and user authorization.

capabilities.name: Scoped contacts resolution
open_gaps: Contacts authorization/composition-root and NLU/UI reachability, provider attendee integration, and live limited/full-access acceptance remain open.
capabilities.notes: Bounded CNContactFetchRequest candidate lookup and tie clarification are implemented; the full address book is never exposed to models.

capabilities.name: VS Code workspace, diagnostics, tasks, and tests
open_gaps: Policy enforcement, typed bounded bridge routes, workspace precedence/ambiguity handling, and coordinator wiring are covered by local integration-simulated evidence; live extension packaging/shared-secret provisioning, complete route acceptance, backend auth/model readiness, durable reviewable writes, voice/UI reachability, restart/resume, and live acceptance remain open.
capabilities.notes: Must not close dirty editors without bound confirmation; the production file bridge remains unavailable unless authenticated configuration is supplied.

capabilities.name: Codex task execution
open_gaps: Live auth/model readiness, user-facing progress/review, diff/test/evidence verification, restart/resume, and helper separation.
capabilities.notes: Read-only version/help health evidence is bounded and keeps auth/model readiness degraded; write-capable routing fails closed until readiness and workspace/worktree gates pass.

capabilities.name: Claude Code task execution
open_gaps: Live auth/model readiness, workspace/extension route, UI progress, restart/resume, and end-to-end verification.
capabilities.notes: Do not assume current CLI flags without official verification.

capabilities.name: GitHub Copilot task execution
open_gaps: Live supported interface, auth, local/cloud consent, workspace resolution, UI progress, restart/resume, and verification.
capabilities.notes: Cloud execution boundaries must be explicit.

capabilities.name: Durable task queue and recovery
open_gaps: Full Task Center, live agent progress, user resume/retry, crash/restart system evidence, and test-runner runtime repair.
capabilities.notes: Core durable task engine now enforces deadline/inactivity bounds and binds latest checkpoint recovery; runtime acceptance remains open.

capabilities.name: Provenance-aware memory and context
open_gaps: Production reference-candidate population is incomplete; no launched-app user inspection/correction/export/deletion UI, user-present cross-session demonstration, or remote transport evidence.
capabilities.notes: Bounded local memory/context policy and explainability metadata are implemented and integration-tested; product activation and live acceptance remain open.

capabilities.name: Typed capability registry and planner
open_gaps: Natural-language multi-step decomposition is still unwired: the structured-NLU layer proposes at most one capability per turn, so no user sentence produces a multi-step plan. ToolRouter.routePlan and AuraKernel.executePlan exist and are reachable, but a caller must supply the steps. Closing this needs a new model prompt/schema plus per-step hallucination guards and live verification.
app.discover, app.hide, task.status, and task.cancel remain reachable only via direct AuraKernel calls, not the bilingual NLU classifier or any UI control.

Capability-health rows exist in the SwiftUI Capabilities tab but are not reachable through the Accessibility tree in this build; health truth was proven via the registry snapshot and the policy-gated capabilityHealthSnapshot path instead (R9 scope).
Voice-driven reachability is unproven: all live evidence is text-input only because the operator is speech-disabled.
capabilities.notes: ToolRegistry/ToolContract (the prior closed five-intent switch) deleted; CapabilityRegistry is the sole production source for user-reachable tools. See ADR-038. SP-004 added the four filesystem/URL adapters, SP-005 made them NLU-reachable, and SP-006 proved the registry -> policy -> adapter spine live on the running app (real OS effects, live local model, no registry bypass), which is what raises this row to live_verified/ui_reachable. SP-006 also found and fixed two live defects: the .reversible filesystem/URL capabilities had no seeded policy grant, and handleFileOpen misrouted folder slots to the file validator. The SP-006 follow-up (EV-SP-006-20260816-GAPCLOSE-04) put CapabilityPlanner on the production path: ToolRouter builds and fingerprints a validated plan for every routed intent, and routePlan/executePlan execute multi-step plans in dependency order with typed skip/partial-failure outcomes and per-step declared rollback strategies. implementation_state stays partial only because natural-language multi-step decomposition is still unwired.

capabilities.name: Deny-by-default policy and confirmation
open_gaps: Consistent enforcement across VS Code/computer-use/new adapters and program-wide R2-R12 acceptance remain open.
capabilities.notes: SP-001 / OPEN-02 directly proves the redacted confirmation lifecycle, cancellation, truthful execution/verification, and restart no-replay for the bounded AURA path; this does not close other adapter or first-pass gates.

capabilities.name: Enforced network allowlist
open_gaps: Endpoint and redirect checks cover the Ollama loopback client, but a mandatory factory/boundary for every URLSession, provider, redirect, DNS, and subprocess network path is not proven.
capabilities.notes: Policy object and one client boundary exist; complete enforcement does not.

capabilities.name: OAuth and Keychain secret handling
open_gaps: PKCE/state/redirect/scope and Keychain expiry/revoke contracts are tested, but provider token exchange/callback wiring, account isolation, live revocation, and leakage prevention across all support paths remain open.
capabilities.notes: Secrets must be referenced, never copied into events or prompts; the active transport is not wired.

capabilities.name: Least-privilege automation and agent helpers
open_gaps: Typed helper envelopes and capability allowlists are tested, but the pipe is not authenticated XPC, helper executors are echo-only, and the main app retains Accessibility, generated input, shell, CLI, and network powers.
capabilities.notes: Required before strong OS-enforced confinement claims; plugin trust/update evidence remains open.

capabilities.name: Developer ID signed and notarized distribution
open_gaps: The deterministic artifact/manifest slice is local and development_unverified only; CI retention is configured but no post-change run was observed; no Developer ID, secure timestamp, notarization, staple, DMG/PKG, or clean external-machine evidence exists.
capabilities.notes: Local package verification is not public distribution readiness.

capabilities.name: Signed updates, launch at login, safe mode, and recovery
open_gaps: Manifest validation is not an updater. No signed package transport, Sparkle/approved updater integration, rollback/downgrade protection, launch-at-login implementation, safe mode, support bundle, migration, uninstall, or factory reset evidence.
capabilities.notes: Design prose and local manifest contracts are not an operational updater. ADR-046 remains Proposed.
